Question ID: CW_U01_L07_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.COM.04

The draft line is: "The hallway swallowed the final bell." Question: Which response best demonstrates workshop feedback?

answer.text: A. This response changes the meaning of the passage.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This does not provide clear, standards-aligned craft reasoning.

answer.text: B. This response judges the writer instead of the writing.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This does not provide clear, standards-aligned craft reasoning.

answer.text: C. clear feedback should name a craft choice and reader effect.

feedback.text: Correct. This names the craft choice and explains the effect and stays aligned to Creative Writing craft work.

answer.text: D. This response ignores the craft choice named in the question.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This does not provide clear, standards-aligned craft reasoning.
